adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent and deleteEvent, the new fallback logic is incorrect: when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, it executes `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`, but `externalCalendarId` is undefined/null in that branch, so `.find()` will almost always return undefined. This removes the prior behavior of falling back to the event’s destination calendar externalId, causing updates/deletes to target an undefined calendarId (or inadvertently fall back to default behavior depending on downstream handling), which can break reschedule/cancel paths.
